files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A personal about section beside a portrait: a badge, the heading, a lead, then key facts and a list of
  specialities, or skill chips and expertise bars, and one or two links. Axes: layout (facts, skills),
  mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Skill, AboutMeLabels } from "./about-me.types";
import type { Spec } from "./product-info.types";
import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

export type AboutMeProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  facts: Spec[];
  skills: Skill[];
  labels: AboutMeLabels;
  actions: LinkActions;
  layout?: "facts" | "skills";
  mediaSide?: "start" | "end";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Progress from "../compose/Progress.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  level = 1,
  facts,
  skills,
  labels,
  actions,
  layout = "facts",
  mediaSide = "start",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<AboutMeProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge, level }"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :tone="tone"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'facts')">
      <List
        v-if="((facts?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
        tag="ul"
        class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2"
        data-slot="facts"
      >
        <ListItem
          v-for="f in facts"
          :key="f.id"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-0 p-4"
          data-slot="fact"
        >
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ f.label }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ f.value }}
          </Text>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
    </template>
    <Stack v-else-if="((skills?.length ?? 0) > 0)" gap="4" align="stretch" data-slot="skills">
      <Stack v-for="s in skills" :key="s.id" gap="2" align="stretch" data-slot="skill">
        <Group gap="4" justify="between">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ s.label }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(labels.level, s.level) }}
          </Text>
        </Group>
        <Progress :value="(s.level == null ? undefined : String(s.level))" max="100" :aria-label="s.label" />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <ActionGroup
      :primary="actions.cta"
      :primaryHref="actions.href"
      :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
      :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
    />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
